biotools.summary: fastppm is a tool for fast tumor phylogeny regression via tree-structured dual dynamic programming, supporting various convex loss functions. It significantly improves speed and accuracy compared to existing regression algorithms and can be incorporated into existing phylogeny inference algorithms.
